headline: A House resolution that would have condemned the Speaker for not seating five Republicans on the January 6 select committee and urged her to appoint them, but the House tabled it.
what_it_does: This resolution would have stated the House's disapproval of Speaker Nancy Pelosi's decision not to seat all five Republican members the Republican leadership proposed for the Select Committee to Investigate the January 6th Attack on the United States Capitol. It would have urged the Speaker to appoint Representatives Jim Banks, Jim Jordan, Rodney Davis, Kelly Armstrong, and Troy Nehls to that committee. The House voted to table it, which ended its consideration.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the House of Representatives
who_it_affects.how: Five Republican members would have been asked to join the select committee investigating the January 6 Capitol attack.
The Speaker would have been formally condemned and urged to appoint the five named members to the committee.
